about_the_game: "Endless Night" is a narrative Texas Hold'em game independently developed by independent developers. The game takes place in a mysterious medieval castle, where unaware people will face the deadly game of the night watchman. You will play as the protagonist who, due to an accident, accepts the challenge issued by the night watchman - a five-day poker game with life as the stake. In the game, you will also encounter mysterious demon merchants who will exchange special abilities in a terrifying transaction. You need to face multiple challenges while searching for the only hope on the edge of life and death.

content_descriptors.notes: This game features mature themes of a life-and-death challenge, which are presented through narrative text and dialogue from the beginning. There are no visual depictions of violence, blood, or sexual content.

Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows® 7 / 10 / 11
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3-2120 或 AMD® 同等级别
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel® HD Graphics 3000 或 AMD® Radeon™ HD 6450 或 NVIDIA® GeForce® 610（支持OpenGL 2.1）

short_description: "Endless Night" is a story-driven poker adventure. After a fateful accident, you must win a five-day poker game with your life on the line. To survive, make deals with demon merchants for supernatural powers. Can you master the cards and find hope in the endless night?
